goal: Bring Jane Street's socratic-tutor skill into agent-kit so Beau can be tutored to mastery of a topic, without it competing with teach.
changed: New essentials skill socratic-tutor, adapted from janestreet/agent_skills @ 7c6715c (MIT), with its license in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and a line in docs/UPSTREAM.md.
The adaptation rewrites the prose plainly, shows the bar characters instead of describing them, and gives save state a fixed block format that can be written to a file and resumed.
teach's description points quiz and drill requests at socratic-tutor; the tutor points code and change explanations at teach.
essentials is 0.3.0 and bstack is 0.41.2, each with a changelog entry.

claims.claim: Generated files, validation and the unit tests pass.
claims.check: make gen, make validate claude-validate (42 skills, 0 errors) and make test (1322 tests, OK, 24 skipped) on macOS.
claims.remaining: CI's validate run on this pull request is the second check.

claims.claim: An agent following the skill starts a session on 'tutor me on X' and answers a plain 'what is X' question directly.
claims.check: Two fresh subagents read the SKILL.md. On 'tutor me on TCP congestion control' one listed 8 subskills, announced the diagnostic and asked one question, then stopped. On 'what is TCP slow start?' the other answered it with no quiz.
claims.remaining: One sample each on the same model. Not checked: routing between teach and socratic-tutor when both are installed, or a full multi-turn session through to the final assessment.
